outOfScope: Tuning product behavior during release acceptance.
Changing packaging/runtime behavior to make a frozen release candidate pass.
Executing release-reserve tasks before exact release freeze.
Treating CI success, merge state or a working-tree demo as release value evidence.
Claiming a SLSA level or certification; SLSA provenance fields are design guidance only.
constraints: Worker execution requires exact DONE BB-074 and BB-075 plus compatible delivered distribution/profile evidence; incompatibility yields PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
Release freeze binds source/tree, dependency-resolution manifest, supported profile, HOW policy, build/install procedure and produced artifact digests before release-reserve model execution.
BB-076 is the first task allowed to execute BB-075 RELEASE_RESERVE; any prior model result invalidates the reserve.
All release-reserve and lifecycle evidence must run against the packaged/frozen release, not working-tree product code.
Missing/unknown primary cost or incomplete registered evidence yields INCONCLUSIVE, never implicit success.
invariants: Application owns work semantics and domain authority; Oracle owns source IO; runtime success is not acceptance or publication authority.
Every result binds exact source, attempt, configuration and evidence; unknown effects or missing evidence cannot be called success.
The outer Blackboard schedules ExHarness development only; product runtime coordination remains a separate system.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Consume exact DONE BB-074 and BB-075 decisions and the supported install/distribution/profile evidence; BB-076 performs acceptance only and cannot tune product behavior.

D2 — Freeze a release candidate before paid evaluation: source commit/tree, dependency-resolution manifest digest, supported harness/profile, current HOW policy, build/install procedure, builder/runtime identity, artifact digests, benchmark protocol hashes and release-reserve manifest hash.
D3 — Emit SUPPORTED_RELEASE_PROVENANCE_V1 inspired by SLSA provenance v1.2 fields for source, resolved dependencies, builder/invocation and produced artifact subjects. Do not claim a SLSA level.

D4 — Clean-room reproduction starts from a fresh supported environment with no working-tree checkout and installs only frozen artifact(s) by digest. It verifies manifest/provenance, dependency/runtime compatibility, actionable missing-credential failure, reference delivery and independent QA.
D5 — BB-076 is first opener of the four BB-075 RELEASE_RESERVE tasks. Prior model execution, cohort overlap or digest drift invalidates the reserve and returns to research.

D6 — Release value arms are D=DIRECT_CODEACT control and R=ExHarness installed from the frozen release artifact. Same Harbor substrate, model/provider, task, prompt, tools, evaluator, budgets and human-event semantics apply.
D7 — Run four release-reserve tasks x two repeats x two arms = 16 registered arm units with counterbalanced order, fresh state and append-only attempt accounting.

D8 — Release value gates are: accepted R>=D with zero critical escaped defects; operator active time R<=0.80*D; known provider cost per accepted R<=1.10*D; no duplicate effects/currentness bypass and required recovery negatives pass.

D9 — Re-run all six BB-074 lifecycle scenarios on the packaged release and bind independent acceptance, operator effort, elapsed, cost when live, recovery/fence outcome and failure fingerprint to the exact release provenance.
D10 — Generate SUPPORTED_RELEASE_MANIFEST_V1 from delivered evidence and compare it to user-facing support docs; unsupported claims or omitted known limitations fail release acceptance.

D11 — A deterministic reducer returns RELEASE_ACCEPTED, RELEASE_NO_GO or INCONCLUSIVE. Complete evidence plus any required gate failure is RELEASE_NO_GO; missing/unknown/drifted primary evidence is INCONCLUSIVE.
D12 — Product/package source writes are forbidden in BB-076. If release acceptance exposes a packaging/product defect, no-go and route repair upstream instead of patching inside acceptance.
implementationSlices: S1 — Resolve exact DONE BB-074/075 and compatible delivered distribution/profile evidence, verify RELEASE_RESERVE has no prior model execution and freeze source/tree/policy/profile/build/dependency identities.
S2 — Build the frozen release artifact(s), emit SUPPORTED_RELEASE_PROVENANCE_V1 and verify artifact digests plus resolved dependency/runtime identity.
S3 — Reproduce from a fresh supported environment using only frozen release artifacts; verify provenance/manifest, run reference delivery + independent QA and one change/recovery preflight.
S4 — Execute all 16 D/R release-reserve registered arm units with fixed factors, fresh state and complete attempt/provider/human-event accounting.
S5 — Execute all six required BB-074 lifecycle scenarios against the packaged release and bind acceptance/recovery/currentness evidence to exact release provenance.
S6 — Generate SUPPORTED_RELEASE_MANIFEST_V1 and audit support docs/known limitations against delivered evidence.
S7 — Run the frozen RELEASE_ACCEPTED|RELEASE_NO_GO|INCONCLUSIVE reducer and update Living truth only with the independently verified result and limitations.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The frozen release artifact is cryptographically bound to exact source/tree, dependency lock, supported profiles, build/runtime identity and benchmark bindings through SUPPORTED_RELEASE_PROVENANCE_V1.
evidenceRequired: Release provenance, artifact digests and independent verification output.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A fresh supported environment with no working-tree product code installs only frozen artifacts, verifies identity and completes reference delivery plus independent QA and a change/recovery preflight.
evidenceRequired: Clean-room environment identity, install logs, provenance verification, reference-delivery and independent QA evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: BB-076 is the first model execution of the exact BB-075 RELEASE_RESERVE and completes all 16 fixed-factor D/R registered arm units with complete attempt/accounting evidence.
evidenceRequired: Reserve manifest/access audit, unit manifests, raw attempts and normalized records.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Release-reserve quality, human-effort, provider-economics and safety/currentness gates all pass on the frozen packaged release.
evidenceRequired: Deterministic gate inputs/outputs and paired release-reserve report.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: All six required delivery lifecycle scenarios pass against the packaged release with exact provenance bindings.
evidenceRequired: Per-scenario acceptance, effort, recovery/fence and failure evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: SUPPORTED_RELEASE_MANIFEST_V1 and user-facing support documentation match delivered capabilities and known limitations.
evidenceRequired: Machine-readable manifest, documentation audit and mismatch negatives.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Only complete passing evidence returns RELEASE_ACCEPTED; complete required-gate failure returns RELEASE_NO_GO and missing/unknown/drift returns INCONCLUSIVE.
evidenceRequired: Reducer matrix and mutation tests for every outcome path.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Application owns work semantics and domain authority; Oracle owns source IO; runtime success is not acceptance or publication authority.
evidenceRequired: Negative case proving packaged runtime success cannot redefine acceptance/publication authority.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every result binds exact source, attempt, configuration and evidence; unknown effects or missing evidence cannot be called success.
evidenceRequired: Missing/stale artifact/source/accounting identity cannot be represented as current release success.

negativeVerificationCases: Release artifact digest differs from provenance or installed source/profile identity.
Clean-room run reads working-tree/uncommitted product files.
Source, dependency lock, HOW policy, supported profile or build recipe changes after release freeze.
RELEASE_RESERVE model result predates BB-076 or overlaps prior benchmark tasks.
Unknown primary provider cost represented as zero.
Fewer than 16 registered release-reserve units represented as complete.
Direct and release arms use different evaluator, model/provider, tool envelope or resource budget.
Any required lifecycle scenario omitted or run only against working-tree code.
Duplicate effect or stale-worker/currentness bypass tolerated because quality passes.
Support documentation claims unsupported behavior or hides known limitation.
CI/merge success substituted for release value evidence.
Failed value/lifecycle/identity gate downgraded to a limitation instead of RELEASE_NO_GO.

laneContracts.input: exact READY plan + DONE direct dependencies
laneContracts.convergence: all acceptance claims SATISFIED + evaluated source merged

livingDocs.statement: BB-076 Living truth describes only the implemented and independently verified supported capability and limitations.

releaseFreezeContract.invalidation: any mutation after freeze requires a new release candidate identity before release-reserve execution

provenanceContract.guidance: SLSA provenance v1.2 field model; no SLSA level claim

valueGateContract.quality: accepted units R >= D and criticalEscapedDefects=0
valueGateContract.safetyCurrentness: duplicate external effects=0, stale-worker/currentness bypass=0, required recovery negatives pass

lifecycleContract.target: packaged frozen release, never working-tree runtime

decisionContract.accepted: verified provenance/artifact/source identity + clean-room acceptance + complete 16-unit release-reserve comparison + all value gates + all six lifecycle scenarios + support-doc consistency
decisionContract.noGo: complete valid evidence and any required identity/value/lifecycle/documentation gate fails
decisionContract.inconclusive: missing registered unit, unknown primary cost, provider/infra gap preventing evaluation, invalid reserve provenance or incomplete lifecycle evidence
decisionContract.authority: frozen deterministic reducer; Jev validates evidence claims and cannot rewrite outcome

dependencyResolution.workerStart: Consume the exact dependency-resolution manifest/digest emitted by the delivered BB-073-supported distribution path. Do not assume a root lockfile exists.
dependencyResolution.contradiction: If the delivered distribution has no reproducible dependency-resolution identity, BB-076 cannot claim exact release provenance and must return PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
